concept: Moving through a long list a page at a time: round 44px steps, the current page chosen glass, Previous and Next at the ends.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a row of bordered square buttons with a blue current page (Bootstrap pagination)
default_to_avoid.why_not: bordered squares with a blue current page bring a hue and a box per number

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the current page is chosen glass and semibold, announced as the current page

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: every step is a 44px round target, in every theme and on every scene

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: numbers are tabular so the row does not shift as pages change

options: A round steps with chosen glass
variants.picked: A round steps with chosen glass
variants.reason: A is the system’s chosen pane. B boxes every number. C loses the place in the list.

root.why: Previous, the pages and Next in a row

pages.why: the page numbers with ellipses, the same in every theme and on every scene

step.why: a round 44px step, the same in every theme and on every scene

edge.why: Previous and Next with their words, the same in every theme and on every scene

gap.why: an ellipsis in secondary text where pages are skipped

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which item has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours mark the current item with the system highlight

hover.why: a step lightens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-current=page.why: the current page is chosen glass, the same in every theme and on every scene

disabled.why: Previous on the first page and Next on the last use the disabled opacity

aria-current.why: the current item does not lighten on hover, because it is already the chosen pane

background-color.why: the tint eases at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
